rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Gives AI agents real infrastructure for autonomous operation through the AgentLair platform. Agents can send and receive email via custom @agentlair.dev addresses, store credentials in zero-knowledge encrypted vaults, create calendar events, and communicate with other agents through WebSocket-based real-time channels. Supports multi-tenant pod isolation for sandboxed environments.
